description: The soft reset back to the title screen. hold: holding all of these buttons for longer than vblanks (60 per second) resets; name is the cause written to the log. combos: holding exactly "held" and newly pressing any of "pressed" resets. demo_vblanks: a demo running longer than this returns to the title. blocked_below_state: no reset in any game state before this one (boot, logos, intro); blocked_steps: no reset at these steps of these states (while a save is being read or written). Button names: Select, Start, Triangle, Circle, Cross, Square, L1, L2, R1, R2. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
